arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
path='/workspace/tmp/fuzz_value.py'
lines=open(path).read().split('\n')
out=[]
started=False
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('def main():'):
        started=True; out.append(line); continue
    if started and line.startswith('if __name__'):
        started=False; out.append(line); continue
    if started and line.strip() and not line.startswith('    '):
        out.append('    ' + line); continue
    out.append(line)
open(path,'w').write('\n'.join(out))
EOF
python3 /workspace/tmp/fuzz_value.py 0 2>&1 | tail -2 && for seed in 1 2 3; do python3 /workspace/tmp/fuzz_value.py $seed 2>&1|tail -1; done
